text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that wasn't a bad result at all!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Though the Goddess of Victory's smile
has been put on hold for now—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad everyone had a great time!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: When I think about it that way, I wonder if I managed to add a touch of grace to the stage that is racing...?
choice_data_list: You were shining bright again today!

Let's make the next act our greatest one yet.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha.
So that's how you felt about me!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to shining as an entertainer,
I don't intend to lose to anyone.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
I'll entertain everyone in the next race too!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
I'm not satisfied with today's results either.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What's expected of me is an even higher level. For that, I don't care how tough the training gets...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Wait for me, everyone!
"Fuji Kiseki" will grow even stronger...!
